build_CpuGpuOffloadingHandlers: build CpuGpuOffloadingHandlers to allocate CPU tensors and create GPU-to-CPU and CPU-to-GPU offloading handlers for KV cache
create_SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler_: create SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler and call transfer_async to submit an asynchronous KV cache block transfer job
test_SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler_ge: test SingleDirectionOffloadingHandler.get_finished to poll and collect completed transfer results with timing metrics
review_compute_sub_block_ptrs: review compute_sub_block_ptrs to compute byte pointers for sub-blocks of block IDs in non-contiguous tensors
summarize_pin_mmap_region: summarize pin_mmap_region to register a shared offload mmap region as CUDA pinned memory via cudaHostRegister
